capabilities: Execute Python scripts placed in canvas text nodes via a command
Chain multiple scripts into workflows with typed inputs and outputs
Pass node data to scripts by overlapping nodes or pointing edges into them
Auto-install missing Python modules with pip from scripts
Inject stored variables such as API tokens into scripts with explicit permission
extras: Requires a local Python installation (path auto-detected or set manually); some example scripts write output to a plugin data folder that must be manually created if changed from the default.
problem: Obsidian Canvas nodes are static, so there is no built-in way to run code that processes node contents or writes results back onto a canvas.

relations.evidence: You can manually install by adding Kay607/obsidian-canvasblocks to BRAT

summary: Canvas scripting plugin that executes Python scripts on Obsidian Canvas nodes, either as one-shot simple scripts or chained workflows.
